items.text: I will serve as an Associate Editor for the 2027 European Control Conference.
Our paper "Safe and Stable Filter Design Using a Relaxed Compatibility Control Barrier-Lyapunov Condition" was accepted by Automatica.
I attended EuroGNC 2026 and gave a tutorial talk on CBF design using convex optimization.
One paper was accepted by Automatica.
Our paper on convex co-design of control barrier functions and state feedback controllers appeared in IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control.
One paper was accepted by ICLR 2026.
Our work on spatially informed Gaussian process UCB for decentralized coverage control appeared at the European Control Conference.
Our paper on distributed safe control design and probabilistic safety verification for multi-agent systems appeared in Automatica.
Our paper on constraint horizons in model predictive control appeared in IEEE Control Systems Letters.
